errata.orig: The occurrence of route-record AVP in AAA is 0+.
errata.correct: The occurrence of route-record AVP in AAA should be 0 according to AAA definition of section 3.2.
errata.notes: In 3GPP Rx application TS 29.214, AAA command contains no route-record AVP either. So section 10.1 of RFC4005 needs to be corrected.
